text: A substantial proportion of children and adolescents with emotionally based school avoidance (EBSA) do not benefit from outpatient mental health interventions. In such instances, more intensive interventions may be warranted. There is a lack of synthesised knowledge, however, to guide professionals and families about what intensive interventions comprise, how they generate change, and when they are indicated.
source_label: Intensive interventions for emotionally based school avoidance: a scoping review of program structures and therapeutic levers
